details: The cryptocurrency industry experienced approximately $110 million in losses due to hacks in July. This occurred while cybersecurity platform Immunefi reported an increase in confirmed bug bounty activity.
title: Crypto Industry Faces $110 Million Loss from July Hacks

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) sold 1,690 Bitcoin, bringing its USD reserve to $4.65 billion. This strategic move adjusts the company's significant Bitcoin holdings.
title: MicroStrategy Sells 1,690 BTC Amidst Treasury Shift

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin emphasized privacy and quantum resistance as key focuses in the network's updated development roadmap. This indicates a long-term vision for enhanced security and user anonymity.
title: Ethereum Roadmap Prioritizes Privacy and Quantum Resistance

details: Shares of Bitcoin mining company Bitdeer dropped by over 15%, even as the firm reported strong revenue growth across its Bitcoin mining and AI infrastructure verticals. The company posted a net loss of $92.3 million.
title: Bitcoin Miner Bitdeer Shares Sink 15% Despite Growth

details: Bitcoin miner Keel has decommissioned all its U.S. Bitcoin mining operations. The company plans to convert these sites into data centers for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing, also selling a large portion of its Bitcoin.
title: Keel Shutters All US Bitcoin Mining Operations for AI Pivot

details: Trump Media and Crypto.com have mutually agreed to terminate their proposed partnership, which included plans for a CRO-focused digital asset treasury company. The decision cites "prevailing market conditions and shifting business priorities."
title: Trump Media Ends Crypto.com Partnership

details: Worldcoin (WLD) saw a 12% price increase on Monday, driven by Eightco Holdings' disclosure of owning 302 million WLD tokens. This signals continued institutional interest and robust retail demand for the cryptocurrency.
title: Worldcoin (WLD) Advances on Eightco Holdings Accumulation
